org: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

events.title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
events.quote: In light of the progress on inflation and the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/2 percentage point to 4-3/4 to 5 percent.
events.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System · FOMC 声明
